product: zero-trace uninstaller for vibe coders (one icon, click, app never existed)

criteria.question: Can it do 100% of the uninstall job (scan registry, delete files/services/tasks/env, no scanner traces)?
User steps from download to working product?
Failure modes and hard dependencies (browser running? network? third-party service? store review)?

Time/complexity to MVP for a solo builder?
Store review, AV false positives, signing risk?
Runtime RAM/disk on the user's PC (measured)?
